name: CouchSpire (couch co-op)
author: CouchSpire fork of LocalMultiControl by liwenhao0427 and GuyGinat
description: Couch co-op on one screen: each controller drives its own character in a local multi-character run. Press a button on your controller to take over when your teammate isn't mid-action. Based on Local Multi-Control (DualRoleAdventure); do not enable both.
